entities.summary: Economic Miracle and WTO Accession, a transformative movement in China (1992–2012). Emerged from Tiananmen Square massacre — military crushes pro-democracy protests and Third Plenum launches 'Reform and Opening Up' — transforming China's economy. Catalyzed Southern Tour and China joins the World Trade Organization.
